show.description: Textile billionaire Aryan hides his identity as a humble do-gooder—until his fiancée Jessica betrays and humiliates him in public. When Ananya, a fierce CEO on the brink of losing her empire claims him as her husband, their fake marriage ignites love, revenge, and a high-stakes power clash that will expose truths, destroy enemies, and redefine loyalty.
